title: Braiding reverses an exact dual pair without symmetry
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a monoidal category [def-sfb-monoidal-category], equipped with a braiding $\sigma_{A,B}:A\otimes B\xrightarrow{\sim}B\otimes A$, natural in both variables and satisfying the two hexagon identities. Let $P,Q$ be objects and let $c:\mathbf1\to P\otimes Q$ and $e:Q\otimes P\to\mathbf1$ satisfy the two triangle identities $(1_P\otimes e)(c\otimes1_P)=1_P$ and $(e\otimes1_Q)(1_Q\otimes c)=1_Q$, with the canonical associators and unitors inserted. Then the maps $c^\prime=\sigma_{Q,P}^{-1}\circ c:\mathbf1\to Q\otimes P$ and $e^\prime=e\circ\sigma_{P,Q}:P\otimes Q\to\mathbf1$ satisfy the two triangle identities for the ordered pair $Q,P$. No equation $\sigma_{B,A}\sigma_{A,B}=1$ is assumed.
